findings.summary: the analytic-oracle flux contours are not visible: render_panel.py:97-119 draws the oracle at zorder=3 under the fast-route contours at zorder=4 on the same nine levels, and the two fields agree to 1e-5 of the span, so the delivered render shows one contour set. Measured on the PNG, blue fast-route ink is 18,539 px in the plot body against about 1,100 non-marker grey px, and the grey survives only as 706 fragments none larger than 50 px outside the two null glyphs. A reader therefore cannot see the oracle field beside the fast one, cannot distinguish perfect agreement from a series that was never drawn, and has to take the fragment's figcaption on trust for the panel's central claim.

the delivered PNG predates the caption code at the reviewed head: the rendered caption reads 'terminal fresh residual 1.208e-12 Wb, ... boundary 2.59e-05 a', while render_panel.py:154-156 at 2ab0afa3 emits no 'Wb' and writes 'boundary ... span'. The panel was therefore not re-rendered after that fix, and the caption a reader sees still labels the boundary-flux error (a fraction of the flux span) with the minor-radius unit 'a', restating a headline precision number in the wrong normalisation.

the outermost contour level is drawn as seven detached blue fragments rather than a closed curve: components of 157, 156, 103, 68, 45 and 24 px at x=844-861 in the upper right and around y=527-624 below the X-point, plus two grey vertical slivers at x=537-539 and x=861-863. At a glance these read as stray marks near the vessel edge rather than as part of a level, which costs the reader contour count and makes the already-hidden oracle slivers harder to tell apart from them.

raw_text:
RUBRIC legibility: the wall, six nested blue flux contours, the axis marker and the X-point marker are readable at a glance, but the analytic-oracle contour set the panel exists to compare against is not visible as a set: only isolated grey slivers survive over zorder=4 fast-route contours, so a reader sees one field where the caption promises two.
RUBRIC data_ink: pass: 18,539 blue ink pixels against 745 grey pixels in the two null markers and 3,530 dark pixels over the whole canvas, and the wall is a thin unfilled outline; the contours, markers and wall carry the weight and nothing else is drawn.
RUBRIC decoration: pass: no gradient, background fill, shading or styled theme; the canvas is white, the wall is a thin black line, and the legend is frameless.
RUBRIC contrast: pass: the caption and legend text are near-black on white, and the neutral grey legend entry (#676767) clears roughly 5:1 against white.
RUBRIC table_form: pass: the panel is a poloidal line-contour map of poloidal flux with the wall and both null sets, which is spatial information and not something naturally a table.
RUBRIC label_collision: pass: the legend sits above the plotted field (blue data ink starts at y=129, the legend ends at y=118) and the caption occupies its own band at y=678-696 with no plotted ink in it; the fast and oracle null markers are concentric at the axis and the X-point, which the fragment's figcaption explains is the expected rendering when the two null sets agree to about 7e-6 m at this scale.
